## Checklist

- [ ] A bug fix comes with a test that fails without it.
- [ ] Every new string is in `packages/i18n`, in en, pt-BR and zh-CN.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally.
- [ ] If this touches sign-in, authorization, tenancy, OAuth/MCP, the administration, files, the database schema, the CSP or CI: `docs/security/` is updated.
- [ ] Nothing about a real deployment: no hosts, IP addresses, secrets or real e-mail addresses.
